evidence_summary: Initial evidence for oral turmeric/curcumin in knee osteoarthritis is positive but not definitive.
Conventional oral products appear likely safe in recommended amounts for up to about 2–3 months.
Enhanced-bioavailability products have been linked to liver injury in some users.
Turmeric supplements may be unsafe in pregnancy; breastfeeding safety above food amounts is uncertain.
personalization: Use only validated indication- and formulation-specific evidence; goals and symptoms alone do not establish deficiency or benefit.
review_tasks: Validate source references and population-specific outcomes
Resolve canonical question IDs and conditional safety gates
Do not infer supplement dose from RDA, AI, UL or unrelated trial protocol
